# Actions, resources, and condition keys for Amazon S3

Amazon S3 (service prefix: `s3`) provides the following
service-specific operations, resources, actions, and condition keys for use in IAM permission
policies.

References:

- Learn how to [configure this service](../../../AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.md "../../../AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.md").
- View a list of the [API operations available for
  this service](../../../AmazonS3/latest/API.md "../../../AmazonS3/latest/API.md").
- Learn how to secure this service and its resources by
  [using IAM](../../../AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-control-overview.md "../../../AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-control-overview.md") permission policies.
- View the [programmatic service authorization
  reference](https://servicereference.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/v1/s3/s3.json "https://servicereference.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/v1/s3/s3.json") for this service.

###### Topics

- [API operations defined by Amazon S3](#list_s3-operations "#list_s3-operations")
- [Actions defined by Amazon S3](#list_s3-actions-as-permissions "#list_s3-actions-as-permissions")
- [Permission-only actions for Amazon S3](#list_s3-permission-only-actions "#list_s3-permission-only-actions")
- [Resource types defined by Amazon S3](#list_s3-resources-for-iam-policies "#list_s3-resources-for-iam-policies")
- [Condition keys for Amazon S3](#list_s3-policy-keys "#list_s3-policy-keys")

## Actions defined by Amazon S3

You can specify the following actions in the `Action` element of an IAM
policy statement. Use policies to grant permissions to perform an operation in AWS. When
you use an action in a policy, you usually allow or deny access to the API operation or CLI
command with the same name. However, in some cases, a single action controls access to more
than one operation. Alternatively, some operations require several different actions.

                                                                                                  | Description ## Permission-only actions for Amazon S3

The following actions are defined by Amazon S3 but are not directly
invocable through any API operation. They can only be used in IAM policy statements
to grant or deny permissions.

| Actions                                                                                                                                                                               | Description                                                                                                 | Resource types (\*required)                                     | Condition keys                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | Access level |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------ |
| [InitiateReplication](../../../AmazonS3/latest/userguide/setting-repl-config-perm-overview.md "../../../AmazonS3/latest/userguide/setting-repl-config-perm-overview.md")              | Grants permission to initiate the replication process by setting replication status of an object to pending | [object\*](#list_s3-resource-object "#list_s3-resource-object") | [aws:ResourceTag/${TagKey}](#list_s3-aws_ResourceTag___TagKey_ "#list_s3-aws_ResourceTag___TagKey_")<br>[s3:BucketTag/${TagKey}](#list_s3-s3_BucketTag___TagKey_ "#list_s3-s3_BucketTag___TagKey_")<br>[s3:ResourceAccount](#list_s3-s3_ResourceAccount "#list_s3-s3_ResourceAccount")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | Write        |
| [PauseReplication](../../../fis/latest/userguide/fis-actions-reference.md#bucket-pause-replication "../../../fis/latest/userguide/fis-actions-reference.md#bucket-pause-replication") | Grants permission to pause S3 Replication from target source buckets to destination buckets                 | [bucket\*](#list_s3-resource-bucket "#list_s3-resource-bucket") | [aws:ResourceTag/${TagKey}](#list_s3-aws_ResourceTag___TagKey_ "#list_s3-aws_ResourceTag___TagKey_")<br>[s3:authType](#list_s3-s3_authType "#list_s3-s3_authType")<br>[s3:BucketTag/${TagKey}](#list_s3-s3_BucketTag___TagKey_ "#list_s3-s3_BucketTag___TagKey_")<br>[s3:destinationRegion](#list_s3-s3_destinationRegion "#list_s3-s3_destinationRegion")<br>[s3:ResourceAccount](#list_s3-s3_ResourceAccount "#list_s3-s3_ResourceAccount")<br>[s3:signatureAge](#list_s3-s3_signatureAge "#list_s3-s3_signatureAge")<br>[s3:signatureversion](#list_s3-s3_signatureversion "#list_s3-s3_signatureversion")<br>[s3:TlsVersion](#list_s3-s3_TlsVersion "#list_s3-s3_TlsVersion")<br>[s3:x-amz-content-sha256](#list_s3-s3_x-amz-content-sha256 "#list_s3-s3_x-amz-content-sha256") | Write        |
